verdict.rationale: Riveter is a data-enrichment API and SaaS with SDKs and a local MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. Dry_run and max_credits are billing controls, not privacy settings, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
